sources.page: List of extinct bird species since 1500

extinct-since-1500.note: Species and subspecies with an English common name; the bulleted lists give it as "Common name (Binomial)", and lines with only a binomial are left out. A few well-known losses (dodo, aurochs, Javan tiger) added by hand.

penguins.note: Plus the extinct Chatham and Waitaha penguins, and "Rockhopper penguin" for both rockhoppers.

national-animals.note: Every animal listed, national fish and insects included; heraldic forms (Bundesadler, Leo Belgicus) folded into Eagle and Lion.

wild-cats.note: Domestic cat left out; generic Lynx, Wildcat and Golden cat added.

marsupials.note: Extinct mammals only of the marsupial orders; kinds (kangaroo, possum, quoll) added by hand.

rodents.note: List of rodents gives genera: only the common name in brackets is taken ("Anomalurus (scaly-tailed flying squirrel)"). Recently extinct rodents from List of recently extinct mammals.

flightless-birds.note: The article's bulleted species; plus all penguins and a few famous prehistoric ones (terror bird, Gastornis, Hesperornis, Dromornis).

monkeys.note: Kinds (baboon, macaque, tamarin) added by hand.

wild-canids.note: Domestic dog and the extinct Falkland Islands wolf and Dusicyon avus left out; dingo and New Guinea singing dog added at the edge.

deer.note: Musk deer and chevrotains (Moschidae, Tragulidae) accepted at the edge.

sources.page: List of snakes by common name

snakes.note: Merged with Wikidata: species under Serpentes (Q25537662) with an English article and a common name (title, label or P1843).

antelopes.note: Cattle, buffalo, bison, sheep, goats, ibexes, tahrs and the muskox left out; goat-antelopes (serow, goral, chamois, takin, mountain goat) and the pronghorn kept.

dog-breeds.note: Breeds from the page's bulleted lists, extinct ones included; crossbreeds accepted at the edge.

horse-breeds.note: Breeds, pony breeds, colour breeds and crossbred registries; modern and archaic types left out.

domesticated.note: All of table 1; from table 2 (tamed and semi-domesticated) only the well-known ones (reindeer, elephant, hamster, budgerigar, goldfish).

not-monkeys.note: Plus kinds, and a few extinct hominins and giant lemurs a player may name.

hybrids.note: Only hybrids with a name of their own (liger, zorse, wholphin); individuals, hypothetical and hoax hybrids left out.

ducks-geese-swans.note: Plus the magpie goose and the domestic duck and goose.

sources.page: List of extinct bird species since 1500

pigeons-doves.note: Extinct pigeons and doves (dodo, Rodrigues solitaire, passenger pigeon) from the Columbiformes section of the extinct birds list.
